title: No Totem Drops
description: No more Totem drops from Evoker. Feel the true Hardcore.
body:
### No Totem Drops from Evokers – Feel the Hardcore.

This simple datapack removes Totem of Undying drops from Evokers. Instead, Evokers will only drop emeralds, making raids a little harsher and survival more unforgiving.
